description: The Acterys Smart XL Visual brings the power and flexibility and writeback ease of Excel directly into Power BI, allowing users to create dynamic, cell-based reports and planning forms with ease. It dramatically improves processes by offering Excel’s familiar interface within Power BI, reducing the learning curve and time to value. Profit from the quickest possible realization of complex cell-based reports and planning form layouts that cannot be realized in a rigid matrix. Add custom calculations where needed without the need for complex DAX and run enterprise level planning and master data management with direct data writeback to a central database. All this with interactive integration of Power BI’s groundbreaking analysis and visualization options. Features: Reports exactly as needed with Excel-like cell-based reporting and formulas that flexibly adapt Automatic updates based on central data model and interaction with Power BI visuals Flexible planning forms with real-time connection to central data in minutes Effective editing of master data in large user environments Key Benefits: Smart Migration: Seamlessly migrate existing Excel reports into advanced planning and reporting applications.
